questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects the evidence and interpretation emphasized in Week 16?
choices: Effective review organizes knowledge by chronology, geography, themes, and recurring analytical skills.
Mongol military success drew on mobility, organization, intelligence, diplomacy, and the fragmentation of opponents.
Global comparison requires the same analytical categories while preserving regional context.
Trade networks depended on many short-distance exchanges, political protections, transport technologies, and credit relationships.
questions.explanation: Mongol military success drew on mobility, organization, intelligence, diplomacy, and the fragmentation of opponents.

questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects the evidence and interpretation emphasized in Week 16?
choices: Merchants moved religions, artistic forms, languages, technologies, crops, and diseases as well as luxury goods.

questions.prompt: Which statement best reflects the evidence and interpretation emphasized in Week 16?
